query:
UPDATE workspace_settings
        SET git_sync = jsonb_set(git_sync, '{repositories}',
            COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(
                CASE WHEN elem->>'git_repo_resource_path' = $2
                THEN CASE WHEN $3::jsonb = 'null'::jsonb
                     THEN elem - 'credential'
                     ELSE jsonb_set(elem, '{credential}', $3) END
                ELSE elem END)
             FROM jsonb_array_elements(git_sync->'repositories') AS elem), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
        WHERE workspace_id = $1
          AND jsonb_typeof(git_sync->'repositories') = 'array'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(git_sync->'repositories') AS e
              WHERE e->>'git_repo_resource_path' = $2
          )
